hypothesis: Pairing low-address rows with their mirrored high-address counterparts may distribute each block's GM transactions across opposite row-address regions while retaining balanced row counts. No performance benefit is assumed without device measurements.
change: For rowCount == 128 and rowWidth == 16384 with blockCount <= 64, assign two-row tasks by pair p = localPairOrdinal * blockCount + blockIdx, mapping the task rows to p and rowCount - 1 - p. Assign the partial tail pairs to the first blockCount remainder blocks. For blockCount > 64, preserve R052 phase-rotated single-row ownership; other shapes preserve GetBalancedRowRange. Input loads, prefetched loads, and output stores use the same mapping. Arithmetic, tile sizes, UB buffers, and reduction logic are unchanged.

ownership_validation.command: node -e 'const n=128;for(let b=1;b<=n;b++){const symmetric=b<=64,g=symmetric?2:1,m=n/g,q=Math.floor(m/b),r=m%b,seen=new Uint8Array(n),loads=[];for(let j=0;j<b;j++){const groups=symmetric?q+(j<r?1:0):q+(((j+q)%b)<r?1:0),rows=[];for(let k=0;k<groups;k++){if(symmetric){const p=k*b+j;rows.push(p,n-1-p)}else rows.push(k*b+((j+k)%b))}if(rows.some(x=>x<0||x>=n||seen[x]))throw Error(`invalid/duplicate b=${b} block=${j}`);for(const x of rows)seen[x]=1;loads.push(rows.length)}if(seen.some(x=>x!==1))throw Error(`gap b=${b}`);if(Math.max(...loads)-Math.min(...loads)>(symmetric?2:1)||Math.min(...loads)<1)throw Error(`balance b=${b}`)}console.log("symmetric-end-pair mapping: N=128, B=1..128; coverage/uniqueness/nonempty/balance PASS")'
ownership_validation.raw_output: symmetric-end-pair mapping: N=128, B=1..128; coverage/uniqueness/nonempty/balance PASS; assignments differ from adjacent pairs in 2080 block cases
invariants: For every tested blockCount, rows cover [0, 128) exactly once with no out-of-range rows.
Every block receives at least one task for the supported 1 <= blockCount <= 128 range.
Per-block row counts differ by at most two rows when blockCount <= 64 and by at most one otherwise.
For blockCount <= 64, each two-row task maps to one low-address row and its distinct mirrored high-address row.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static mapping validation only; not runtime correctness, physical-core behavior, or performance validation.

scope_check.details: For C13/C14 and blockCount <= 64, paired rows change from adjacent or phase-rotated neighbors to opposite ends of the row range. Each row's GM tile remains contiguous. For larger blockCount, existing phase-rotated row ownership is unchanged.
